description.value:
Frequency once per day

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature under HEAT DEBT

You draw the chill back out of the target and spend it against your own ledger. HEAT DEBT ends on that creature, and your Reckoning drops by one stage. You cannot drop below Stage 0, and a stage removed this way can be advanced into again normally — this pays the ledger down, it does not close it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reducing the Reckoning by one stage (this card also removes HEAT DEBT, itself a homebrew condition with no schema representation anywhere in the corpus) -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER).
